'''Dorel-Kan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who became a high-ranking member of the [[Cularin Pirates]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].

==Biography==
Dorel was the brother of [[Vel-Kan]] and he regretted Vel had refused to serve as his first mate. He captained a pirate ship and among his crew was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept]] [[Reeayah]], who Dorel had a very close working relationship with. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]] in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Dorel and his ship were present in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. Reeayah used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to track the ''[[Neeva-Beelo]]'', a potential target for the pirates. It docked in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], so Dorel landed his ship there and along with Reeyah and ten human pirates, he attacked the ''Beelo''{{'s}} crew, the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
